name: 3 × DGX Spark
label: 3 × DGX Spark
basis: Includes all three systems and their internal storage. Idle: 35 W each. Working: two at 90 W and one at 35 W. Heavy: 190 W each.[^p-spark-test][^p-spark-idle]

name: MS-A2: Ryzen 9 9955HX, 96 GB, all 3 SSDs
label: MINISFORUM MS-A2
basis: Includes 96 GB RAM and all three SSDs, with extra allowance over the review configuration.[^p-msa2]

name: Beelink N150: 16 GB, SSD + 5 TB USB HDD
label: Beelink N150 + USB HDD
basis: Includes the mini PC, internal SSD, and a spinning 5 TB USB hard drive. Estimated from the components.

name: GMKtec K15: 32 GB, internal SSD + 4 TB NVMe
label: GMKtec K15
basis: Includes both internal drives. The external GPU dock is counted separately.[^p-k15]

name: QNAP TS-464: 4 × 8 TB HDDs + 4 TB NVMe
label: QNAP TS-464 + all drives
basis: Includes four spinning hard drives, the NVMe tier, enclosure, and fan. Higher loads allow for transfers and RAID activity.[^p-qnap]

name: NETGEAR GS108E
label: NETGEAR GS108E
basis: Eight Gigabit ports, VLAN support, fanless, and non-PoE. The 3–5 W estimate allows for connected ports and the power adapter.[^p-switch]

name: DEG2 + V100 32 GB + 2 TB NVMe + 4 Noctua fans + GF A3 PSU losses
label: DEG2 + V100 + SSD + cooling
basis: Includes one V100, the DEG2, 2 TB SSD, four Noctua fans, and PSU losses. Heavy load allows 250 W for the GPU; the K15 is separate.[^p-v100][^p-fans]

name: Custom i5 microbench: 8 GB + HDD, excluding FPGA
label: Custom i5 microbench
basis: Includes the i5 host, 8 GB RAM, HDD, and PSU losses. The FPGA has its own row. Estimated from the components.

name: One installed PCIe FPGA card
label: One installed PCIe FPGA
basis: One installed PCIe card, using the Stratix V as the example. Power varies with the card and bitstream.

name: TANG Primer 20K
label: TANG Primer 20K
basis: USB-powered board, counted separately from the PCIe FPGA.

name: Orange Pi 6
label: Orange Pi 6
basis: Includes the board, storage, cooling, and power adapter. Estimated from the components.

name: M5Stack ESP32-S3 device
label: M5Stack ESP32-S3
basis: Includes the ESP32-S3 device and its peripherals. Estimated from the components.

name: M5Stack AX630C LLM module
label: AX630C LLM module
basis: Includes the AX630C module and power-conversion allowance. The M5Stack host is separate.[^p-m5]

name: Agent Blade: all 9 ESP32 nodes + SD NAND
label: 9-node Agent Blade
basis: Projected draw for all nine ESP32 nodes, SD NAND, and board power conversion. Working: about 0.8 W per S3 and 1.5 W per P4, plus 2.7 W overhead.

name: Seeed E1001 ePaper / ESP32 display
label: Seeed E1001 ePaper
basis: Periodic screen updates with sleep between refreshes.

name: 7.84-inch rack touchscreen
label: Rack touchscreen
basis: Screen on; brightness affects consumption.

name: KC-KVM801 + keyboard and mouse
label: KVM + keyboard + mouse
basis: Includes the KVM electronics, keyboard, and mouse.

name: HDMI capture + connected recovery USB devices
label: Capture + connected USB
basis: Includes connected capture and USB devices.

name: 2 × 120 mm rack fans + their DC supply
label: Rack fans + DC supply
basis: Both rack fans and their DC supply. GPU cooling is included in the dock row.

name: PDU and volt/amp/watt/kWh meter electronics
label: PDU + meter electronics
basis: Power used by the meter and PDU electronics.

name: CyberPower 750 VA UPS overhead
label: UPS overhead
basis: UPS losses and maintenance charging, assuming an essential-load branch. Excludes battery recharge after an outage.
